Title: Azure Active Directory B2C meter IDs will change on August 1, 2020

Body.Content:
Effective August 1, 2020, the resource GUIDs (also known as meter IDs) for Azure Active Directory B2C monthly active users will change.

There won't be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on resource GUIDs.
